description: This file contains functions for setting up taxes and charges in an ERP system, including converting simple tax data to detailed structures, creating tax templates, managing accounts, and updating regional tax settings.

methods.name: setup_taxes_and_charges
methods.description: Main function to set up taxes and charges for a given company and country, loading data from JSON and converting it into detailed templates.

methods.name: simple_to_detailed
methods.description: Converts a simple tax object into a detailed data structure suitable for ERP templates.

methods.name: from_detailed_data
methods.description: Creates tax and charge templates from detailed data, including sales, purchase, and item taxes.

methods.name: update_regional_tax_settings
methods.description: Updates regional tax settings based on country-specific modules.

methods.name: make_taxes_and_charges_template
methods.description: Creates or updates a taxes and charges template in the database.

methods.name: make_item_tax_template
methods.description: Creates an item tax template in the database.

methods.name: get_or_create_account
methods.description: Checks for an existing account or creates a new tax account if none exists.

methods.name: get_or_create_tax_group
methods.description: Finds or creates a tax group account based on root type and company.

methods.name: make_tax_category
methods.description: Creates a tax category if it does not already exist.
